reason: Conversation 2 immediately and correctly explained 22E as a fridge evaporator-fan fault, asked targeted questions (freezer status, vents, frost at the rear panel), recommended the sensible unplugged 24-48h manual defrost with proper safety caveats (no chipping ice, no panel removal), and on recurrence correctly escalated to an engineer for the fan/defrost components while explicitly warning against buying a fan blindly. Conversation 1 never explained the code, repeated the same generic questions verbatim twice despite clear answers, wasted turns on settings/eco mode/door-left-open checks, and after nine exchanges had still not reached a diagnosis, defrost suggestion, or escalation. Only minor gaps in 2 were omitting warranty discussion and a slightly odd generic image attachment, which do not offset 1's failure to progress.
